topic: Write and apply database schema migrations safely

defects.detail: SKILL.md links to references/migration-checklist.md, which in turn links to references/locking-rules.md. The table-locking guidance that appears in the body (lines 37-45 of SKILL.md) should only appear in locking-rules.md, creating an unnecessary nested reference chain.
The Migration Frameworks section lists 'Alembic, Flyway, or raw SQL scripts' without stating which is the default or recommended choice for the team.
Body text uses second-person imperative voice: 'You should choose', 'You should plan', 'You should always have' violates the third-person policy for skill bodies.
Text contains 'Until June 2026 the staging cluster runs Postgres 14', a dated conditional that will become stale and misleading.
